The union of the Who's On First region records Galway (85685097), Roscommon (85685113), Leitrim (85685133), Sligo (85685137), Mayo (85685145). A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 26 records, at least 99 percent of those places are under one division.
